req.title: Mark task complete
req.statement: The system shall set completed=true when a PUT payload includes {"completed": true}.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the functionality of marking a task as complete via the PUT /tasks/{task_id} endpoint. It includes tests for positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage and mutation resilience.

tests.name: test_mark_task_complete_positive
preconditions: A task with id 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with payload {'completed': true}.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a task to ensure it exists
create_response = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Test Task', 'description': 'Test Description', 'completed': False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()
task_id = created_task['id']

# Positive test: Mark task as complete
response = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'completed': True})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()['completed'] is True

tests.name: test_mark_task_complete_negative
preconditions: No task with id 999 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/999 with payload {'completed': true}.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Negative test: Attempt to mark a non-existent task as complete
response = client.put('/tasks/999', json={'completed': True})
assert response.status_code == 404
assert 'Task with id 999 not found' in response.json()['detail']

tests.name: test_mark_task_complete_boundary
preconditions: A task with id 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with payload {'completed': false}.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a task to ensure it exists
create_response = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Test Task', 'description': 'Test Description', 'completed': True})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()
task_id = created_task['id']

# Boundary test: Mark task as incomplete
response = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'completed': False})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()['completed'] is False
